specification.objective: Refresh only the four issue-119 workspace sidebar snapshots from the canonical Ubuntu 24.04.5 x64 / Flutter 3.47.2 render for candidate 34657a6c751d1e2a571264d6060383a99d07c903, and record the exact source run and hashes without changing application behavior.

requirements.statement: Each updated desktop/mobile and light/dark snapshot is byte-identical to its actual image from canonical CI run 40753762985 for candidate 34657a6c751d1e2a571264d6060383a99d07c903.
The validation README records the canonical run ID, candidate SHA, Ubuntu and Flutter versions, and SHA-256 for each updated PNG.
No runtime source, golden matcher, or non-golden test behavior changes; the full non-golden Flutter suite remains green.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All four issue-119 PNGs match the reviewed actual images from run 40753762985 byte-for-byte; no other snapshot is changed.
README provenance identifies run 40753762985, candidate SHA 34657a6c751d1e2a571264d6060383a99d07c903, Ubuntu 24.04.5 x64, Flutter 3.47.2, and each PNG SHA-256.
The project-policy non-golden Flutter tests pass locally, and the canonical Ubuntu visual-golden job passes on the resulting PR head.

invariants.statement: Do not change production UI, golden matcher tolerance, CI failure semantics, or non-golden tests.
Only canonical Ubuntu 24.04 x64 / Flutter 3.47.2 actual images tied to the stated candidate commit may become snapshots.

forbidden_states.statement: A local macOS/arm64 render or image from another candidate commit is used as a canonical snapshot.
Any image lacks matching run/hash provenance or any unrelated snapshot is modified.
The canonical visual test is skipped, weakened, or non-golden tests regress.

inputs.statement: Clean committed baseline 34657a6c751d1e2a571264d6060383a99d07c903, the existing workspace shell golden test, and canonical CI run 40753762985.
Ubuntu 24.04.5 x64 / Flutter 3.47.2 artifact actuals and expected/diff images for all four issue-119 visual cases.

outputs.statement: Four reviewed canonical issue-119 screenshots and a README with their CI provenance and SHA-256 hashes.

failure_semantics.statement: Any PNG hash mismatch, missing source provenance, non-golden test failure, or failed canonical Ubuntu golden job blocks completion.
